title: Keep mention completion inside the scratch copy when a folder is a link
text: Mention completion lists the files of a thread's scratch copy, and its listing checks only the last segment of each path. If a folder in the copy is replaced by a link to somewhere outside it, the files of that old folder are still listed and offered. Make completion keep only paths whose every parent folder resolves inside the copy. A path whose parent is missing or resolves outside the copy is dropped, and files under ordinary folders are offered as before.

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout.
